name: nursing-vp-sim
description: Nursing Virtual Patient Simulator — LLM-powered medical history interview training

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.api:spec: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -c "from main import app; import json; json.dump(app.openapi(), open('../openapi.json','w',encoding='utf-8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2); print('spec written')"
scripts.api:update: npm run api:spec && npm run api:generate
